title: Destination-free gates make the two updates agree
body:
## Summary
- If the destination is not a source, the symbolic XOR and the sequential ADD write the same register, including when a source repeats.
- Sources `(0, 0)` and `(1, 0)` diverge: the sequential operator re-reads its own write.
- Partial receipt only. No new kappa, and no gate census.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/gate-dest-free-agreement/verify.py`
